params.prompt:
Photorealistic studio photograph of the exact same toddler boy shown in the reference images (image 1 is the original photo, image 2 is the approved straight-on front view of the same child, image 3 is a close crop of his head from image 2). He is about three years old. Keep his identity exactly: the same face, very full rounded cheeks, small button nose, soft round chin, warm olive skin, brown eyes, the same round dark tortoiseshell glasses with clear lenses, the same dark brown hair slicked back on top with a clean skin fade around the sides and back, the same hairline, the same toddler head-to-body proportions. Same outfit: plain white crew-neck T-shirt, beige shorts with rolled hems, bare feet.

HEAD AND SHOULDERS PORTRAIT: framed from mid-chest up, the entire hairstyle inside the frame with space above it, shoulders inside the frame, head centred, head upright and level, not tilted.

He is STANDING upright, not sitting or crouching, shoulders square to the camera. Tight crop: the bottom edge of the frame cuts across his upper chest just below the T-shirt sleeves. Only his head, neck, both shoulders and upper chest are in the frame. No forearms, no hands, no shorts, no legs. His head fills about 36 percent of the frame height, with clear empty background above the hair and beside both shoulders, and the full width of both T-shirt sleeves inside the frame.

VIEW: straight-on front view, facing the camera, looking into the lens. Both ears visible. One small diamond stud in the ear on the LEFT side of the image (his own right ear). The other ear has no earring.

Warm ivory seamless studio background, soft even studio lighting. Camera at the child's eye level, level horizon, 85mm lens look, no wide-angle distortion. Neutral, gently curious, quietly confident expression, mouth closed. Natural skin texture and fabric texture, a real photograph. No props, no text, no logos, no labels, no watermark. Not a cartoon, no enlarged eyes, no plastic skin, no adult facial proportions.
